import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    static final int BASE = 1000000;

    static int n, tot, ans;
    static int[] sum = new int[15];
    static List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[15];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void dfs1(int k, int num) {
        if (k == 7) return;
        tot++;
        int val = ((tot - num) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
        v[k].add(val);
        sum[k] = (sum[k] + val) % MOD2;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(k + 1, num * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * BASE + BASE - 1 <= n && x * BASE * 10 > n) {
            int curTot = tot;
            for (int i = 0, mul = 1; i <= 6; i++, mul *= 10) {
                int sz = v[i].size();
                int diff = ((curTot - x * mul) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
                int pos = lowerBound(v[i], (MOD1 - diff));
                ans = (int)((ans + (long)diff * sz + sum[i]) % MOD2);
                ans = (int)((ans - (long)MOD1 * (sz - pos) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2);
                tot += sz;
            }
            return;
        }
        tot++;
        ans = (int)((ans + ((tot - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }
        tot = 0;
        ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(i);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
